title: Auto acceptance evaluator picks a vendor that is refusing every spawn on its usage limit
outcome: When termal_evaluate_acceptance is called without an agent, Auto does not choose a Claude/Codex vendor that just refused a spawn on its usage limit; it falls back to the other ready vendor or the caller's own agent, and the choice and its reason are visible in the request's answer.
acceptance: After a child of vendor V fails with a usage-limit refusal, an Auto evaluation request within a bounded window does not choose V while the other vendor or the caller's agent is ready, shown by a behavioral test.
The request's answer names the chosen agent and, when a vendor was passed over, the reason.
An explicit agent is honoured unchanged.
The tool description states the rule.

completion.summary: Auto acceptance evaluator skips a recently quota-refused vendor for five minutes, discloses fallback/refusal, preserves explicit preferences, and documents the rule. Landed through combo38 with fresh composite pair and eligible exact-tree FULL.
